name: There is Only Doom
description: Doom's legend is built here in layers: his origin and its retellings, his sieges of the Fantastic Four, and his bids for cosmic power. It moves from Fantastic Four to the Ultimate retelling, Books of Doom and Werner von Doom. Doomquest in Iron Man, the Silver Surfer and the Power Cosmic, Secret Wars, Infinity Gauntlet and Infamous Iron Man follow.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
